name: Villa Mallorca
signature: Two suites in a Majorcan finca-style property — hosts Paul and Sheree Steel have over 212 TripAdvisor reviews naming them independently
editorNote:
Two suites in a Majorcan finca-style property in Mt Martha, with Mediterranean gardens, a salt pool, and bay and valley views. The structural argument is not the architecture — it is the hosts. Paul and Sheree Steel have over 212 TripAdvisor reviews naming them independently across multiple years: Paul plays Spanish guitar on the terrace on no fixed schedule; Sheree delivers home-cooked food to the door unannounced. Neither is available as an add-on at a managed hotel.

The host is not incidental to the stay. At Villa Mallorca, Paul and Sheree are the product. From $390 per couple per night; dinner-B&B from $520. Not suitable for children aged one to ten.
whyWeGo: Paul and Sheree Steel: 212 TripAdvisor reviews naming them independently — the most documented host quality on the Peninsula.
ifOnlyOneThing: Take the dinner-B&B rate rather than the room-only — it removes the one decision you have to make.
